engines.how: A true two-card infinite of deaths, -1/-1 counters, Snakes and drain — but NOT mana: the returned Druid is a new object, so 302.6 blocks its tap ability and it produces three green on the first pass and zero thereafter. Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots restores the mana as a three-card, main-phase-only line.

Real, but three cards: Ballista removes its own counters to reset undying, and an external free sacrifice outlet is required to drive the loop — 001 rules the self-kill pattern off, since a counterless Ballista under Mikaeus is a 1/1 and 704.5f never fires. Once running, the line converts to damage. 001's ruling: 'Mikaeus + Walking Ballista is real but three cards.'

Yawgmoth is the one mana-free outlet that also supplies the repeatable -1/-1 counter undying needs, but 001 rules a second body mandatory for his activation, making it a 3-4 card assembly that collapses to three because Hapatra's Snakes supply the body. The loop is real and bounded by Yawgmoth's mandatory draw: it ends when the library does.

The combo DB records Mikaeus plus each free outlet — Viscera Seer, Carrion Feeder, Yahenni, Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, Blasting Station — as a two-card infinite. Stack 001 refuted all six: each yields exactly one undying return, because the creature comes back with a +1/+1 counter and 704.8 kills the undying trigger when counter annihilation and death fall in the same SBA check. Hapatra cannot supply the reset; her -1/-1 ability is a combat-damage trigger.
engines.status: refuted — stacks/001-mikaeus-undying-counter-annihilation.json (one undying return each, not a loop)

engines.how: Any 1-toughness creature dying with a -1/-1 counter has Blowfly move a counter onto the next body; each placement is a Snake from Hapatra, and each Snake death continues the chain. Nest of Scarabs and Flourishing Defenses substitute for Hapatra as the token half. 001 explicitly left these entries open: the three Blowfly entries 'belong in their own scenario; nothing here confirms or refutes them.'

Yawgmoth pays 1 life and sacrifices a Snake to put a -1/-1 counter and draw; Hapatra replaces the Snake, Obelisk Spider (or Blood Artist / Zulaport Cutthroat) drains per counter or death. The combo DB records the Spider line as producing a creature lock.

Each Squirrel is a green creature entering, so Ivy Lane Denizen puts a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, which makes another Squirrel. The bracket report names it as the deck's highest-bracket combo signal, but 001 deliberately declined to rest the floor on it because it comes from the same unverified source whose Mikaeus half failed six times over.

The grind engine, not a combo: every Snake is a 1/1 that Skullclamp turns into two cards for one mana, with Bitterblossom supplying additional 1/1 bodies and Yawgmoth as the backup sac-for-cards line.

gameplan: Deploy Hapatra on turn 2 off a dork or a mox, then tutor to a kill: one of the stack-001-verified Mikaeus lines — Devoted Druid, Walking Ballista plus a free sacrifice outlet, or the library-bounded Yawgmoth loop — or the still-unverified Blowfly Infestation chain, and convert the deaths into drain through Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance or Blasting Station. Without the combo it grinds: Skullclamp and Yawgmoth turn 1/1 Snakes into cards, Necroskitter and Crumbling Ashes turn shrunken opposing creatures into your creatures.

keep: The full 8-tutor suite (Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor, Imperial Seal, Grim Tutor, Diabolic Intent, Green Sun's Zenith, Worldly Tutor, Survival of the Fittest) — the top of the cited combo range, and the brief explicitly licenses Game Changers at bracket 4. Per 001, the tutor target that matters is a free repeatable -1/-1 source, not any particular altar.

11 ramp slots weighted toward fast mana (Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual) — the turn-2 Hapatra plan and a bracket whose floor is a turn-4 game length both want mana ahead of the curve.

Three cheap drain wincons (Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance) rather than one large finisher — the median-vs-ceiling structure the threat-density section prescribes, and each converts every loop in the deck.
The 36-land, zero-tapland manabase with 29/29 B/G sources against 22/22 targets and 96.2% on-curve probability in both colours.

The removal suite built from -1/-1 counter placement (Blowfly Infestation, Fume Spitter, Grim Affliction, Contagion Clasp, Serrated Arrows, Crumbling Ashes) — every removal spell is also a Hapatra trigger and a combo piece, the two-jobs-per-card principle the ratios section demands.
Lightning Greaves and Swiftfoot Boots in the protection slots earn a second job 001 documented: either one restores the mana half of Mikaeus + Devoted Druid as a three-card, main-phase-only line.
